name: Find a Startup to Help or Join
description:
**Welcome!**

The official registration page is [here](Startupoasisvirtual.eventbrite.com).

If you are a developer, UX designer, marketer, or anyone else in the tech ecosystem looking to join or help a tech startup, or even just get involved in a project, this event is for you!

We will be introducing projects for you to get involved with during the pitches. There is no group like this on Meetup or in the startup world because we filter out the BS and get you going on a project ASAP.

(Stay inside the Startup Oasis by joining our [newsletter](https://mailchi.mp/startupoasis/meetup)!)

What happens first in the event is startup founders pitch their business or idea to the audience, which is full of the developers, designers, marketers, etc.

If you are interested in one of the projects / startups, you can join one of the founders in a breakout room to continue building, workshopping, and/or onboarding the startup with attendees.

People have been able to start and advance their businesses as a result of this process.

We are meeting on Zoom, the link is here in the listing.

**Agenda:**
**Intros:** During the first 10 minutes, we will give you the history, structure, and future plans of Startup Oasis and open signups for founders that want to pitch their startups.

**Pitches:** Each founder will then get up to 3 minutes to pitch their startup. This format is recommended: name, business, the problem, your solution, target customer base, and your biggest challenge/current need. This part is similar to Shark Tank.

**Breakout Groups:** For the remainder of the event, each founder gets a breakout room, and you can talk to the founders in greater detail about their needs and challenges in a small group setting. This part is similar to a hackathon.

Startup Oasis was created to pierce the illusion of accessibility of startups and tech by creating a grassroots forum for early-stage founders to pitch to those in the tech ecosystem to get real-time feedback for their idea or business.

Use this [link](https://lnk.bio/startup.oasis) to:

* Follow us on LinkedIn
* Join our community on Discord
* Donate to our cause
* Visit our website

**FAQ:**
**Is this event free to attend?** Yes - Startup Oasis will always be free for anyone to attend. If you would like to donate, you can do so directly on our [website](https://donate.stripe.com/eVa2a0dV27Nlb2ofYY). You can also talk to us about volunteer or sponsorship opportunities.

**How do I sign up to pitch?** RSVP here. Right when the event starts, fill out the form and then raise your hand on Zoom. That will also determine the order. You can also buy a VIP ticket to support our cause and guarantee you a spot to pitch. To be eligible to pitch, you must be the cofounder of a technology-based startup. Agencies, consultants, coaches, MLM schemes, and nonprofits are not eligible to pitch, but you can still watch the pitches and join the breakouts.

**What happens after the pitches?** The breakout groups open for the remainder of the event. Each founder gets a breakout room, and you can talk more about their business and needs with them.

**Can I invite other people that I know?** Yes - please have them RSVP here or on the [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/startup-oasis-global) event listing.

**How do I get the most out of this event?**

* Founders - In this event, no money is awarded nor are any winners named. We are not here to critique your pitch, just to help you find teammates, cofounders, and feedback from other professionals. Make sure your pitch is 3 minutes or less and clear about what your biggest needs are.
* Attendees - If you are new to startups and tech, feel free to just watch with no pressure to participate. If you are looking to join a startup or find a side project, make sure you take notes during the pitches to join the group of the founder that you're most interested in helping. Most founders need help with either developing the product or with a go-to-market strategy.
*

**Do we meet in person?** We do this event in Atlanta, GA each month in Midtown at ATDC.

**Content:** We are looking for founders to be interviewed or people to interview founders for short videos. Let us know if you are interested!

name: Maryland Blockchain Association & CryptoMondays Virtual Meetup
description:
Network virtually with those located in the DMV (District of Columbia, Virginia & Maryland) and internationally!

This monthly Monday meeting is hosted by Maryland Blockchain Association, Blockchain Legal Institute, and Blockchain Legal Institute Foundation.

The Maryland Blockchain Association is the Maryland Chapter Lead for CryptoMondays. The MDBA's monthly virtual networking event is hosted monthly on the 1st Monday of each month. If you are interested in establishing a meetup in alliance with the MDBA and CryptoMondays please reach out.

The Maryland Blockchain Association is a trade association dedicated to representing the innovative tech community within Maryland to provide education, economic development and outreach to those within our local community.

CryptoMondays is a decentralized global community that brings together individuals passionate about cryptocurrency and blockchain technology.

The Blockchain Legal Institute is a centralized library of decentralized resources & the only Institute specifically dedicated to help provide continuing education to lawyers, compliance officers, business professionals and those learning about digital assets.

The Blockchain Legal Institute Foundation is a non profit dedicated to developing digital asset educational resources for consumers and families.

Learn about the latest trends in digital currency and blockchain technology, and gain insights into the world of crypto-tokens, Bitcoin, Ethereum as well as updates involving the regulations impacting consumers and businesses within our world of blockchain, IoT, RWA, artificial intelligence, and innovative technology. Expert speakers will cover blockchain security, cryptography, and other relevant topics in the fast-evolving cryptocurrency market.

Whether you are a seasoned investor or new to the world of virtual currency, these virtual events are the perfect opportunity to network locally and internationally with like-minded individuals and expand your knowledge in the realm of enterprise blockchain technology.

Don't miss out on this chance to stay ahead of the curve and explore the exciting opportunities that cryptocurrency and blockchain technology have to offer.

description:

About:
Join us each Wednesday to strengthen relationships and explore post-high school pathways. Get in-person Thread Family planning & support.
Who should attend?
Open to all Thread young people and volunteers looking for programming, resources, activities, and partners to support post high school pathways and plans.
How do I support?
You can RSVP in advance using the links below, or just show up (bring other volunteers and young people with you!) If you like having a specific role you can sign ahead of time
here
, or just ask for a role when you get to the check-in table!!!
Fall Focus: Starting Strong — School, Service Year & What Comes Next!
Fall is a season of new beginnings! As young people head back to
school, college, training programs, and work — and our newest Maryland Corps / Service Year members begin their year of service —
TouchPoint
threadHOURS
is here to help everyone start strong and stay on track.
Each Wednesday at threadHOURS, young people can get hands-on support navigating the opportunities and challenges that come with a new school or program year. Whether they need help adjusting to a new schedule, staying on top of school or Service Year expectations, connecting to resources, solving a problem before it becomes a barrier, or thinking ahead to their next academic or professional step, threadHOURS is a place to check in, get connected, and keep moving forward.
For our
Maryland Corps / Service Year members
, threadHOURS is also a place to stay connected throughout the year — celebrating wins, troubleshooting challenges at their host sites, accessing additional resources and opportunities, and making sure their year of service is building toward what comes next.
How you can roll as a volunteer:
The beginning of a new school, work, or service year is a great time to reconnect with your young person. Ask what they’re excited about, what feels challenging, and what would help them start the year strong. Come to threadHOURS together to make a plan, tackle a next step, or connect with someone who can help.
You don’t need to have all the answers — showing up, asking questions, and helping your young person navigate the transition is exactly the relational scaffolding they need.

Fall Focus: Starting Strong — School, Service Year & What Comes Next!
Fall is a season of new beginnings! As young people head back to
school, college, training programs, and work — and our newest Maryland Corps / Service Year members begin their year of service —
TouchPoint
threadHOURS
is here to help everyone start strong and stay on track.
Each Wednesday at threadHOURS, young people can get hands-on support navigating the opportunities and challenges that come with a new school or program year. Whether they need help adjusting to a new schedule, staying on top of school or Service Year expectations, connecting to resources, solving a problem before it becomes a barrier, or thinking ahead to their next academic or professional step, threadHOURS is a place to check in, get connected, and keep moving forward.
For our
Maryland Corps / Service Year members
, threadHOURS is also a place to stay connected throughout the year — celebrating wins, troubleshooting challenges at their host sites, accessing additional resources and opportunities, and making sure their year of service is building toward what comes next.
How you can roll as a volunteer:
The beginning of a new school, work, or service year is a great time to reconnect with your young person. Ask what they’re excited about, what feels challenging, and what would help them start the year strong. Come to threadHOURS together to make a plan, tackle a next step, or connect with someone who can help.
You don’t need to have all the answers — showing up, asking questions, and helping your young person navigate the transition is exactly the relational scaffolding they need.

name: Save the Date: DefenseTech in Harford County
description: Some of the most important defense innovation in the county is happening right here in our region, and it's time we talked about it. UpSurge Baltimore & GBC are bringing together the people building the future of defense and national security on Tuesday, January 19, 2027, for an evening of conversation, connection, and collaboration at the CONVERGE Innovation Center. CONVERGE helps startups bring biomanufacturing technologies developed at Aberdeen Proving Ground (APG) to market and trains the workforce that will power them, which makes it the right place to start this conversation. The evening will focus on the breakthrough work coming out of APG, the unique challenges defense-sector companies face, where the region's biggest opportunities lie, and how our entrepreneurial ecosystem can step up to support the companies working in this space. You'll be in the room with innovators, technologists, workforce development experts, elected officials, Department of War officials, and the anchor institutions shaping the region's defense and national security future. Together, we'll build the partnerships and shared commitment that will position the Greater Baltimore Region to lead in this field. Register and mark your calendar now. The full program, speaker lineup, and additional details will be announced in the coming months. Stay tuned. You won't want to miss this one.

Who we are:

District of Columbia—Climate Action Network (DC-CAN) is a DC-based action team of volunteers who support Chesapeake Climate Action Network (CCAN) climate justice and clean energy campaigns. We also launch our own climate-related actions.

Mission Statement: 

Our purpose is to work together to improve the health and legacy of Washington DC communities—human and nonhuman alike—by undertaking local campaigns that reverse or prevent climate change and the inequity arising from it. name: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live Color Bash
description:
Family Entertainment Live, one of the world’s leading presenters of family-oriented live events, and Mattel, Inc (NASDAQ: MAT), a leading global play and family entertainment company and owner of one of the world’s most iconic brand portfolios, today announced an all-new theme for the wildly popular Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live™ Color Bash — coming to CFG Bank Arena in Baltimore January 22-24, 2027. 
Following the runaway success of Glow-N-Fire — named the Pollstar Family Show of the Year — Color Bash takes the action to a whole new level, transforming the arena into a full-throttle collision of color. Vibrant paint-splattered trucks, bursts of color, and electrifying lighting turn every smash, and crash, into a vivid spectacle the whole family can see, feel, and remember. 
When the mischievous Skelesaurus drains all the color from Monster Truck Island, it’s up to the crew of Rhinomite™, Mega Wrex™, Tiger Shark™, Bone Shaker™, and Bigfoot® to win it back — one massive stunt at a time, joined by a mysterious new ally – to be revealed this fall! Every wheelie, jump, donut and freestyle run brings the color roaring back, building to a full-arena burst of light, sound, and pure Monster Truck energy. It’s the show you love, reimagined like you’ve never seen it. 
“Color Bash is the most vibrant Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live experience we’ve ever created,” said Ken Hudgens, CEO, Family Entertainment Live. “We took everything fans love about the show — the massive trucks, the jaw-dropping stunts, the can’t-look-away energy — and supercharged it with color. It’s a brand-new way to experience the action live, and we can’t wait to bring it to families in Baltimore in 2027.” 
Before the trucks take the floor, ticket holders can add on the Pre-Show Party for an up-close, hands-on experience. And for fans who want the ultimate day out, a range of VIP packages — including Full Throttle VIP, Pedal to the Metal VIP, and Start Your Engine VIP — offer exclusive pre-show access, official VIP merchandise, and the chance to get up close with the Hot Wheels Monster Trucks before all the smashing 
and crashing begins. The ultimate Full Throttle VIP package includes front-row seats, a backstage tour, and a meet & greet with a monster truck driver and an FMX rider.

(1) How to use your hands to apply pressure to a wound;

name: threadHOURS® at TouchPoint - Ongoing
description:
Every Wednesday | 3-6 pm
Location:
TouchPoint: 3201 Tioga Parkway, Suite P, Baltimore, MD 21215
About:
Join us each Wednesday to strengthen relationships and explore post-high school pathways. Get in-person Thread Family planning & support.
Who should attend?
Open to all Thread young people and volunteers looking for programming, resources, activities, and partners to support post high school pathways and plans.
How do I support?
You can RSVP in advance using the links below, or just show up (bring other volunteers and young people with you!) If you like having a specific role you can sign ahead of time
here
, or just ask for a role when you get to the check-in table!!!
Fall Focus: Starting Strong — School, Service Year & What Comes Next!
Fall is a season of new beginnings! As young people head back to
school, college, training programs, and work — and our newest Maryland Corps / Service Year members begin their year of service —
TouchPoint
threadHOURS
is here to help everyone start strong and stay on track.
Each Wednesday at threadHOURS, young people can get hands-on support navigating the opportunities and challenges that come with a new school or program year. Whether they need help adjusting to a new schedule, staying on top of school or Service Year expectations, connecting to resources, solving a problem before it becomes a barrier, or thinking ahead to their next academic or professional step, threadHOURS is a place to check in, get connected, and keep moving forward.
For our
Maryland Corps / Service Year members
, threadHOURS is also a place to stay connected throughout the year — celebrating wins, troubleshooting challenges at their host sites, accessing additional resources and opportunities, and making sure their year of service is building toward what comes next.
How you can roll as a volunteer:
The beginning of a new school, work, or service year is a great time to reconnect with your young person. Ask what they’re excited about, what feels challenging, and what would help them start the year strong. Come to threadHOURS together to make a plan, tackle a next step, or connect with someone who can help.
You don’t need to have all the answers — showing up, asking questions, and helping your young person navigate the transition is exactly the relational scaffolding they need.

name: Find a Startup to Help or Join
description:
**Welcome!**

The official registration page is [here](Startupoasisvirtual.eventbrite.com).

If you are a developer, UX designer, marketer, or anyone else in the tech ecosystem looking to join or help a tech startup, or even just get involved in a project, this event is for you!

We will be introducing projects for you to get involved with during the pitches. There is no group like this on Meetup or in the startup world because we filter out the BS and get you going on a project ASAP.

(Stay inside the Startup Oasis by joining our [newsletter](https://mailchi.mp/startupoasis/meetup)!)

What happens first in the event is startup founders pitch their business or idea to the audience, which is full of the developers, designers, marketers, etc.

If you are interested in one of the projects / startups, you can join one of the founders in a breakout room to continue building, workshopping, and/or onboarding the startup with attendees.

People have been able to start and advance their businesses as a result of this process.

We are meeting on Zoom, the link is here in the listing.

**Agenda:**
**Intros:** During the first 10 minutes, we will give you the history, structure, and future plans of Startup Oasis and open signups for founders that want to pitch their startups.

**Pitches:** Each founder will then get up to 3 minutes to pitch their startup. This format is recommended: name, business, the problem, your solution, target customer base, and your biggest challenge/current need. This part is similar to Shark Tank.

**Breakout Groups:** For the remainder of the event, each founder gets a breakout room, and you can talk to the founders in greater detail about their needs and challenges in a small group setting. This part is similar to a hackathon.

Startup Oasis was created to pierce the illusion of accessibility of startups and tech by creating a grassroots forum for early-stage founders to pitch to those in the tech ecosystem to get real-time feedback for their idea or business.

Use this [link](https://lnk.bio/startup.oasis) to:

* Follow us on LinkedIn
* Join our community on Discord
* Donate to our cause
* Visit our website

**FAQ:**
**Is this event free to attend?** Yes - Startup Oasis will always be free for anyone to attend. If you would like to donate, you can do so directly on our [website](https://donate.stripe.com/eVa2a0dV27Nlb2ofYY). You can also talk to us about volunteer or sponsorship opportunities.

**How do I sign up to pitch?** RSVP here. Right when the event starts, fill out the form and then raise your hand on Zoom. That will also determine the order. You can also buy a VIP ticket to support our cause and guarantee you a spot to pitch. To be eligible to pitch, you must be the cofounder of a technology-based startup. Agencies, consultants, coaches, MLM schemes, and nonprofits are not eligible to pitch, but you can still watch the pitches and join the breakouts.

**What happens after the pitches?** The breakout groups open for the remainder of the event. Each founder gets a breakout room, and you can talk more about their business and needs with them.

**Can I invite other people that I know?** Yes - please have them RSVP here or on the [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/startup-oasis-global) event listing.

**How do I get the most out of this event?**

* Founders - In this event, no money is awarded nor are any winners named. We are not here to critique your pitch, just to help you find teammates, cofounders, and feedback from other professionals. Make sure your pitch is 3 minutes or less and clear about what your biggest needs are.
* Attendees - If you are new to startups and tech, feel free to just watch with no pressure to participate. If you are looking to join a startup or find a side project, make sure you take notes during the pitches to join the group of the founder that you're most interested in helping. Most founders need help with either developing the product or with a go-to-market strategy.
*

**Do we meet in person?** We do this event in Atlanta, GA each month in Midtown at ATDC.

**Content:** We are looking for founders to be interviewed or people to interview founders for short videos. Let us know if you are interested!

name: Maryland Blockchain Association & CryptoMondays Virtual Meetup
description:
Network virtually with those located in the DMV (District of Columbia, Virginia & Maryland) and internationally!

This monthly Monday meeting is hosted by Maryland Blockchain Association, Blockchain Legal Institute, and Blockchain Legal Institute Foundation.

The Maryland Blockchain Association is the Maryland Chapter Lead for CryptoMondays. The MDBA's monthly virtual networking event is hosted monthly on the 1st Monday of each month. If you are interested in establishing a meetup in alliance with the MDBA and CryptoMondays please reach out.

The Maryland Blockchain Association is a trade association dedicated to representing the innovative tech community within Maryland to provide education, economic development and outreach to those within our local community.

CryptoMondays is a decentralized global community that brings together individuals passionate about cryptocurrency and blockchain technology.

The Blockchain Legal Institute is a centralized library of decentralized resources & the only Institute specifically dedicated to help provide continuing education to lawyers, compliance officers, business professionals and those learning about digital assets.

The Blockchain Legal Institute Foundation is a non profit dedicated to developing digital asset educational resources for consumers and families.

Learn about the latest trends in digital currency and blockchain technology, and gain insights into the world of crypto-tokens, Bitcoin, Ethereum as well as updates involving the regulations impacting consumers and businesses within our world of blockchain, IoT, RWA, artificial intelligence, and innovative technology. Expert speakers will cover blockchain security, cryptography, and other relevant topics in the fast-evolving cryptocurrency market.

Whether you are a seasoned investor or new to the world of virtual currency, these virtual events are the perfect opportunity to network locally and internationally with like-minded individuals and expand your knowledge in the realm of enterprise blockchain technology.

Don't miss out on this chance to stay ahead of the curve and explore the exciting opportunities that cryptocurrency and blockchain technology have to offer.

[www.bli.tools](www.bli.tools)
[www.marylandblockchainassociation.org](www.marylandblockchainassociation.org)
[www.bli.foundation](www.bli.foundation)

Speakers will include those with knowledge about artificial intelligence, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tokens, Blockchain use cases, compliance, business development, DeFi, estate planning, finance, accounting, and so many other relevant topics.

Jacqueline Cooper, JD, NBCT, MA LDT, CCI, BMM: CEO: Blockchain Legal Institute, Founder: Maryland Blockchain Association, Partner of Cogent Law Group, Government Blockchain Association: Co-Chair Legal Working Group & GBA Talk Show Host, Global Blockchain Business Council, Media Ambassador, Author: Bitcoin Cinderella Blockchain Adventure series, Author: The Essential Digital Asset Organizer for Attorneys & Their Clients, Author: How to Use Digital Assets To Fundraise For Your Non Profit

Fall Focus: Starting Strong — School, Service Year & What Comes Next!
Fall is a season of new beginnings! As young people head back to
school, college, training programs, and work — and our newest Maryland Corps / Service Year members begin their year of service —
TouchPoint
threadHOURS
is here to help everyone start strong and stay on track.
Each Wednesday at threadHOURS, young people can get hands-on support navigating the opportunities and challenges that come with a new school or program year. For our
Maryland Corps / Service Year members
, threadHOURS is also a place to stay connected throughout the year — celebrating wins, troubleshooting challenges at their host sites, accessing additional resources and opportunities, and making sure their year of service is building toward what comes next.

Ask what they’re excited about, what feels challenging, and what would help them start the year strong. Come to threadHOURS together to make a plan, tackle a next step, or connect with someone who can help.
You don’t need to have all the answers — showing up, asking questions, and helping your young person navigate the transition is exactly the relational scaffolding they need.

  • To join in person: Meet us at 6:30pm to get to know the team over vegetarian dinner
  • To join virtually: Join our google meet room at 7:00pm for hybrid updates on our campaign priorities and small group actions. 

Who we are:

District of Columbia—Climate Action Network (DC-CAN) is a DC-based action team of volunteers who support Chesapeake Climate Action Network (CCAN) climate justice and clean energy campaigns. We also launch our own climate-related actions.

Mission Statement: 

Our purpose is to work together to improve the health and legacy of Washington DC communities—human and nonhuman alike—by undertaking local campaigns that reverse or prevent climate change and the inequity arising from it. We welcome those who want to organize and build power to address the climate crisis, to live more harmoniously with the environment, and to pass on a liveable planet to generations to come.

name: CA Board of Directors Meeting
Find a Startup to Help or Join
description:
**Welcome!**

The official registration page is [here](Startupoasisvirtual.eventbrite.com).

If you are a developer, UX designer, marketer, or anyone else in the tech ecosystem looking to join or help a tech startup, or even just get involved in a project, this event is for you!

We will be introducing projects for you to get involved with during the pitches. There is no group like this on Meetup or in the startup world because we filter out the BS and get you going on a project ASAP.

(Stay inside the Startup Oasis by joining our [newsletter](https://mailchi.mp/startupoasis/meetup)!)

What happens first in the event is startup founders pitch their business or idea to the audience, which is full of the developers, designers, marketers, etc.

If you are interested in one of the projects / startups, you can join one of the founders in a breakout room to continue building, workshopping, and/or onboarding the startup with attendees.

People have been able to start and advance their businesses as a result of this process.

We are meeting on Zoom, the link is here in the listing.

**Agenda:**
**Intros:** During the first 10 minutes, we will give you the history, structure, and future plans of Startup Oasis and open signups for founders that want to pitch their startups.

**Pitches:** Each founder will then get up to 3 minutes to pitch their startup. This format is recommended: name, business, the problem, your solution, target customer base, and your biggest challenge/current need. This part is similar to Shark Tank.

**Breakout Groups:** For the remainder of the event, each founder gets a breakout room, and you can talk to the founders in greater detail about their needs and challenges in a small group setting. This part is similar to a hackathon.

Startup Oasis was created to pierce the illusion of accessibility of startups and tech by creating a grassroots forum for early-stage founders to pitch to those in the tech ecosystem to get real-time feedback for their idea or business.

Use this [link](https://lnk.bio/startup.oasis) to:

* Follow us on LinkedIn
* Join our community on Discord
* Donate to our cause
* Visit our website

**FAQ:**
**Is this event free to attend?** Yes - Startup Oasis will always be free for anyone to attend. If you would like to donate, you can do so directly on our [website](https://donate.stripe.com/eVa2a0dV27Nlb2ofYY). You can also talk to us about volunteer or sponsorship opportunities.

**How do I sign up to pitch?** RSVP here. Right when the event starts, fill out the form and then raise your hand on Zoom. That will also determine the order. You can also buy a VIP ticket to support our cause and guarantee you a spot to pitch. To be eligible to pitch, you must be the cofounder of a technology-based startup. Agencies, consultants, coaches, MLM schemes, and nonprofits are not eligible to pitch, but you can still watch the pitches and join the breakouts.

**What happens after the pitches?** The breakout groups open for the remainder of the event. Each founder gets a breakout room, and you can talk more about their business and needs with them.

**Can I invite other people that I know?** Yes - please have them RSVP here or on the [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/startup-oasis-global) event listing.

**How do I get the most out of this event?**

* Founders - In this event, no money is awarded nor are any winners named. We are not here to critique your pitch, just to help you find teammates, cofounders, and feedback from other professionals. Make sure your pitch is 3 minutes or less and clear about what your biggest needs are.
* Attendees - If you are new to startups and tech, feel free to just watch with no pressure to participate. If you are looking to join a startup or find a side project, make sure you take notes during the pitches to join the group of the founder that you're most interested in helping. Most founders need help with either developing the product or with a go-to-market strategy.
*

**Do we meet in person?** We do this event in Atlanta, GA each month in Midtown at ATDC.

**Content:** We are looking for founders to be interviewed or people to interview founders for short videos. Let us know if you are interested!

name: Staind - Break The Cycle 25th Anniversary Tour
description:
Featuring Seether and special guests Hoobastank and Hinder 
  
Staind is an American rock band from Springfield, Massachusetts, formed in 1995. The original lineup consists of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Aaron Lewis, lead guitarist Mike Mushok, bassist and backing vocalist Johnny April, and drummer Jon Wysocki. From day one, STAIND’s sound was alternately crushing and comforting. They absorbed the teeth-kicking intensity of groove metal, the melodic grit of grunge, and the diaristic approach of dyed-in-the-wool singer-songwriters into a signature style. They have sold over 15 million records worldwide fueled by the 2x-Platinum Dysfunction [1999], 7x-Platinum Break the Cycle [2001], Platinum 14 Shades of Grey [2003], and Platinum Chapter V [2005]. Along the way, they earned five straight Top 5 debuts on the Billboard 200, including three consecutive #1 entries. “It’s Been A While” logged a staggering 20 weeks at #1 on airwaves, making it “one of the most-played songs in modern rock radio history.  In 2023, they sent Confessions Of The Fallen to #1 on the Billboard Top Active Rock Albums Chart and notched Active Rock Radio #1 hits “Lowest In Me” and “Here And Now.” 2026 saw the beginning of a renaissance when the Break the Cycle deep cut “Warm Safe Place” surged on TikTok giving the band its biggest year yet with over 1 billion annual streams.  Forever pushing forward, STAIND celebrated a seminal moment with 2026’s Break the Cycle (Live) [Alchemy Recordings/BMG], the Break The Cycle 25th Anniversary Tour 
Their album Break The Cycle was released in 2001 via Flip Records and certified 7x platinum selling over 7 million units in the US alone. The album brought the group mainstream success spending three weeks at #1 in U.S. album charts upon release and multiple weeks in international charts. 2026 is the band’s biggest year to date, with the re-release of Break The Cycle 25th Anniversary Live and the nationwide tour, the annual streams have hit 1 billion.

description:
Location: This is a hybrid meeting. RSVP for the meeting link or in-person location

  • To join in person: Meet us at 6:30pm to get to know the team over vegetarian dinner
  • To join virtually: Join our google meet room at 7:00pm for hybrid updates on our campaign priorities and small group actions. 

Who we are:

District of Columbia—Climate Action Network (DC-CAN) is a DC-based action team of volunteers who support Chesapeake Climate Action Network (CCAN) climate justice and clean energy campaigns. We also launch our own climate-related actions.

Mission Statement: 

Our purpose is to work together to improve the health and legacy of Washington DC communities—human and nonhuman alike—by undertaking local campaigns that reverse or prevent climate change and the inequity arising from it. We welcome those who want to organize and build power to address the climate crisis, to live more harmoniously with the environment, and to pass on a liveable planet to generations to come.

One of the defining artists in global dance music, Harris has spent more than a decade creating records that have become part of the fabric of contemporary pop and electronic music. With more than 56 billion global streams, two U.K. No. 1 albums, 11 U.K. No. 1 singles and 31 U.K. Top 10 singles, his catalogue has consistently crossed the boundaries between clubs, radio, festivals and stadiums. 
His recent run of releases has continued that legacy, with “Blessings” featuring Clementine Douglas becoming one of the year’s biggest dance records, peaking at No. 3 on the U.K. Singles Chart and marking his 31st U.K. Top 10 single. He followed with “Ocean” featuring Jessie Reyez and “Release the Pressure” with Kasabian as well as “Satisfy” with Jazzy, continuing his instinct for unexpected collaborations and genre-spanning dance music. 
Harris returns to stages across North America with a show that reflects his extraordinary evolution as a live artist, bringing together a catalogue of global anthems, cutting-edge production and the communal energy that has made him one of the world’s most successful electronic artists.

name: DC-CAN Monthly Meeting [Hybrid Event: In-person and Virtual Options]
description:
Location: This is a hybrid meeting. RSVP for the meeting link or in-person location

  • To join in person: Meet us at 6:30pm to get to know the team over vegetarian dinner
  • To join virtually: Join our google meet room at 7:00pm for hybrid updates on our campaign priorities and small group actions. 

Who we are:

District of Columbia—Climate Action Network (DC-CAN) is a DC-based action team of volunteers who support Chesapeake Climate Action Network (CCAN) climate justice and clean energy campaigns. We also launch our own climate-related actions.

Mission Statement: 

Our purpose is to work together to improve the health and legacy of Washington DC communities—human and nonhuman alike—by undertaking local campaigns that reverse or prevent climate change and the inequity arising from it. We welcome those who want to organize and build power to address the climate crisis, to live more harmoniously with the environment, and to pass on a liveable planet to generations to come.

name: Casual Coding, Chat, & Coffee
description:
Join fellow Python enthusiasts at ZiPani for coffee, coding, and conversation. All experience levels are welcome.

We also love non-python topics, if Python isn't your main language! Open Source, Linux, AI, Web Dev, App development ...

Bring a project, ask for help, share what you’re learning, or simply meet other local developers. We’ll trade ideas about libraries, best practices, side projects, and opportunities.

Drop in when you can and stay as long as you like.

\-\-\-

If you come and can't find us, or if for whatever reason Zipani is closed, ping us in #python on the Tech Frederick Discord ([https://discord.gg/YFKZ9dt66J](https://discord.gg/YFKZ9dt66J))!

name: Hilary Duff: the lucky me tour
description: One of the defining stars of her generation, multiplatinum global icon Hilary Duff returns to the pop world with her boldest and most self-assured project yet, luck… or something. Duff first kicked off her music career with 2003’s 4X platinum Metamorphosis (featuring the Top 40-charting “So Yesterday” and “Come Clean”), then released her platinum-selling 2004 self-titled LP and 2007 autobiographical dance-pop collection Dignity. With those three albums alone selling a collective 15 million copies worldwide, she also established herself as a producer, entrepreneur, philanthropist, and New York Times-bestselling author, all while continuing to deliver standout performances in TV and film, including her award-nominated turn on Darren Star’s “Younger.” Now signed to Atlantic Records, Duff launched a thrilling new chapter with her sixth studio album, luck… or something, her first new music since 2015’s Breathe In. Breathe Out. (a No. 5 debut on the Billboard 200, made with an extensive lineup of producers/co-writers, including Tove Lo and Ed Sheeran). luck… or something debuted at #3 on the Billboard 200, marking Duff’s highest chart position since 2007 and becoming the second-largest debut for a female artist this year. Garnering critical praise from Rolling Stone, Billboard, LA Times, Associated Press, Pitchfork, Glamour and more, the project officially became her sixth career Top 5 entry while simultaneously landing at #2 on Billboard’s Top Album Sales Chart. Internationally, luck… or something has soared to the top of the charts with Top 5 debuts in 6 countries, including #1 in Canada and Australia. Marking her first major tour in over 18 years, Duff’s global headline “the lucky me tour” spans seven countries, with dates across the U.S., Canada, Mexico, the U.K., Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand. Duff also surprised fans with the release of (Mine), a seven-song EP featuring newly re-recorded renditions of her greatest hits including “Come Clean (Mine)” and the beloved anthem, “What Dreams Are Made Of (Mine).
